title: cps-okf — Linked elements payload
description: Linkages between elements (the 'linkages' in MVP setup). Mirrors the ClearPoint element-links shape exactly: for one source element {object, objectId}, a `links` array of targets {object, objectId, fieldId}. The `fieldId` on each target is the linkage-type slot — it names the field that holds the relationship — so the SAME element can carry several kinds of links. Example: an objective linked to a measure is {object:'objective', objectId, links:[{object:'measure', objectId, fieldId:'measures'}]}. Each side may instead be a `ref` (created earlier in this run).

objectId.description: Source element id (existing). Omit/null when using `ref`.

ref.description: Source element created earlier in this run.

links.description: Targets to link to this source. `fieldId` names the linkage type (the field that holds the relationship), e.g. 'measures', 'objectives', 'initiatives'.

objectId.description: Target element id (existing). Omit/null when using `ref`.

ref.description: Target element created earlier in this run.

fieldId.description: Linkage-type slot: the field on the source that holds this relationship (e.g. 'measures', 'objectives').
